summary: Derive replicated training with synchronized gradients and explain batch, loss-scaling and optimizer-step equivalence.
outcomes: Trace replicas, data shards, gradient synchronization and optimizer updates.
Compare distributed and single-process steps under equivalent scaling.
sequence: Work one small single-model gradient step.
Partition the batch across identical replicas.
Test equivalent updates and discuss uneven inputs and failure cases.

visual.question: Why do replicas remain consistent after seeing different examples?
visual.interaction: Step local gradients, reduction and update.

practice.task: Reproduce a small one-step DDP equivalence experiment.
practice.success: Global batch and loss scaling are explicit; parameter updates agree within justified tolerance.
